name: paper-curl-carousel
title: Paper Curl Carousel
description: Full-bleed slider where each slide is a printed sheet: drag its edge (or click/arrow) and it rolls over like a page turning, showing the paper back and casting a shadow on the next sheet. Hovering near an edge lifts the corner. Caption rail with counter, title, caption and prev/next.
darkMode: rail uses shadcn CSS vars (--color-background/foreground/border/muted-foreground); `paper` sets the sheet back colour
mainProps: items: {src, title?, caption?, alt?}[], height (default 100svh, must be definite), autoplay (ms, 0=off), loop, paper (#rrggbb), rail, index/defaultIndex/onIndexChange
notes: Images must be CORS-enabled (Unsplash, same-origin /public, data: URLs); otherwise falls back to plain images. WebGL1 - one shader pass, light on GPU. Same caption-rail design as ink-flow-carousel, so the two pair well on one site.
